verdict.rationale: A probe confirms https://developer.nvidia.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured description of NVIDIA's developer portal, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. However, related agent-friendly formats fail: cuda-toolkit.md returns 404 and no openapi/swagger spec is discoverable, and the llms.txt is generic to NVIDIA's developer ecosystem rather than RTX 5090-specific. Missing for 10: working per-page markdown mirrors, an OpenAPI/swagger spec, and product-specific (RTX 5090) agent docs rather than a generic portal file.
